label: SYNTHETIC-DEMO
description: Planner acceptance cases P1-P9 (docs/SP3_PLANNER_CONTRACT_V0_2.md section 12). Candidates and conflict_pairs are the unchanged section 6.5 output of assess_feasibility at derived_from, with synthetic activities and trusted evidence. Score tables are static mock scores, not SP2 results. Expected projections were derived by hand (see each case's derivation), not recorded from the planner.

cases.case: Two flexible activities, each feasible alone, share one free slot
derivation: Free time is only Nov 2 09:00-10:00. A and B each need one 60-minute sitting in Nov 2 08:00-12:00, so each fits alone but not together.
Valid subsets: {}, {A}, {B}; {A, B} is unschedulable, so it is pruned and never scored (3 evaluations).
{A} and {B} both reach C1 25 (gap 5) with equal later components; ID order picks A at 09:00. B is excluded with NO_TIME.
Every valid subset was scored and none reaches C1 30: PARTIAL, PROVEN_UNREACHABLE with a proof over 3 subsets.

cases.case: Flexible sitting placed around a selected fixed block
derivation: F is fixed at Nov 2 10:00-11:00. X needs 60 minutes in Nov 2 09:30-12:00; with F selected, free time is 09:00-10:00 and 11:00-12:00.
09:30-10:00 is only 30 minutes, so X takes 11:00-12:00, adjacent to F and not overlapping it.
Target C1 30 needs both (+5 each): {F, X} reaches 30. Subsets scored: {}, {F}, {X}, {F, X} (4); no larger set exists, so the search is complete.
Attribution order is F (10:00) then X (11:00).

cases.case: Blocks ending and starting at 15:00 (and 16:00) do not overlap
derivation: A is fixed at Nov 2 [14:00, 15:00) and B at [15:00, 16:00): half-open intervals touch but do not overlap, so feasibility reports no conflict pair.
C needs 60 minutes in Nov 2 13:00-17:00 while free time is 14:00-17:00; with A and B selected it takes [16:00, 17:00).
Target C1 25 from 10 needs all three (+5 each). All 7 non-empty subsets are schedulable: 1 + 3 + 3 + 1 = 8 evaluations.

cases.case: KEEP_TIME block now covered by an ad-hoc busy interval
derivation: K was planned at Nov 2 09:00-10:00 and is kept with KEEP_TIME. A busy interval now removes 09:00-10:00 from free time.
K is still FEASIBLE on its own (08:00-09:00 or 10:00-12:00 fit 60 minutes), but its kept block is outside available time: BLOCK_INVALID.
The planner never releases a keep request: KEEP_CONFLICT before any scoring, with no plan.

cases.case: Previous plan still valid while an equally scored alternative exists
derivation: Previous plan: A at Nov 2 09:00-10:00 and X at Nov 3 10:00-11:00; both are still valid. B (skills, preferred) scores like A.
Every pair reaches C1 30. {A, X} has 0 activity-set changes; {A, B} and {B, X} have 2, {A, B, X} has 1. Changes rank before preference, so {A, X} wins.
X stays at its previous 10:00-11:00 block (0 time changes) instead of moving to the earliest slot 08:00: both activities are KEPT.
With a previous plan there is no dominance pruning: all 8 subsets are scored, then one extra rescore of {A, X} for score_comparison.

cases.case: Previous flexible block is no longer free
derivation: X was planned at Nov 3 09:00-10:00; that hour is now busy. X is still FEASIBLE (08:00-09:00 or 10:00-12:00).
{X} keeps the activity set (0 set changes) with 1 time change; {} leaves a gap of 5. X moves to the earliest valid block 08:00-09:00.
The score is unchanged: the previous set {X} rescored gives C1 25, the same as the new plan.

cases.case: Completed activity that is not yet in the baseline
derivation: D is COMPLETED but not in included_activity_ids; feasibility reports INFEASIBLE with ALREADY_COMPLETED.
D is listed in pending_confirmation (PENDING_CONFIRMATION warning), excluded as NOT_FEASIBLE, and never sent to the scorer.
D is not in P (completed), so it is not dropped and not rescored; P = {A}. A stays at its fixed block: KEPT.
R is REGISTERED (its registration deadline has passed, which feasibility ignores for registered activities) and was in the previous plan.
max_activities is 1. {R} reaches C1 22 (gap 3); {B} reaches 25 (gap 0, 2 activity-set changes). Gaps rank first, so {B} wins.
R is excluded as LIMIT and dropped as LOWER_PRIORITY with registered = true: DROPS_REGISTERED. The registration is not cancelled.
Scored: {}, {B}, {R} (3); then {R} is rescored for score_comparison (C1 22 against 25).

cases.case: Attribution follows the scheduled blocks, not the window opening
derivation: F's window opens at Nov 2 08:00, before G's fixed block at Nov 2 09:00-10:00. With G selected, F's only free slot is Nov 3 09:00-10:00.
C1 22 of cap 30: the first activity in attribution order adds 5, the second only 3. Both are needed for target 30.
The scheduled order is G then F, so G gets +5 and F +3. The mock table also answers the window-opening order (F +5, G +3) to show the difference.
